data.name: Bansidhar
data.gender_notes: Bansidhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bansidhar is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: Ban (शूल) which means shoot or arrow, and Dhar (धर्ता) which means protector or sustainer. Thus, Bansidhar means one who protects using a bow and arrow. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as the protector of the universe. The name Bansidhar carries the meaning “Ban: Shoot, Dhar: Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bansidhar usually hope their child will grow to embody ban: shoot, dhar: protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, protection, and divine intervention.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bansidhar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
